description: Creates a PicJury photo poll: friends vote on which of 2 to 6 photos is best through one link, without signing up. For choices between photos (profile picture, dating photo, outfit, logo, thumbnail, product) that the user wants other people to decide. Photos attached in the chat are not passed to PicJury: the tool shows a PicJury card in which the user picks the photos and gets the vote link and a private link to follow the votes. question is what friends are asked, in the user's language; language sets the language of the PicJury page.

language.description: Language of the PicJury page, the one the user writes in. Other languages: en.

question.description: What friends are asked, in the user's language. Example: "Which photo should be my profile picture?"

name: start_photo_poll
title: Start photo poll
